verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street is an immigration services provider, so offering International Entrepreneur Rule parole is a fair question to ask of it. Its documentation covers O-1, EB-1, and F-1/J-1-to-O-1 transitions, and it addresses founders only through the O-1 route. Nothing in the evidence mentions IER parole or its qualifying-investment thresholds; the generic 'suite of visas' claim does not establish it.
